name: Analista para sem analista e retorno

steps.message: Quantos chamados foram abertos em julho de 2026 na praça Natal pelo analista André Brito?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-07-01' AND created_on < '2026-08-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito'));

SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-07-01' AND created_on < '2026-08-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito')) ORDER BY ticket;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-07-01' AND created_on < '2026-08-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND (analyst_responsible IS NULL OR BTRIM(analyst_responsible) = '');

SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-07-01' AND created_on < '2026-08-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND (analyst_responsible IS NULL OR BTRIM(analyst_responsible) = '') ORDER BY ticket;

steps.message: e quantos com o analista André Brito?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE created_on >= '2026-07-01' AND created_on < '2026-08-01' AND LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Natal')) AND LOWER(BTRIM(analyst_responsible)) = LOWER(BTRIM('André Brito'));
